messages:
maria: Quick proposal — add a small "param bank" and a couple of safety heuristics to the deploy bot so we can reduce copy/paste and speed up rollbacks. Thoughts?

aj: +1 in principle. What exactly would the param bank hold? templates for flags, common pin sets, change-window presets?

maria: Exactly. Think of it as a tiny named library for deploy arguments. Examples: environment presets, canary fractions, pin sets (model/service hashes), and canonical change windows. Then a single deploy command can reference them.

sam: Love it. Would like built-in rollback heuristics too — e.g. auto-unwind if errors spike >3% over baseline or p99 latency >200ms for 5m. That would avoid manual jump-to-rollback during noisy hours.

ops_lead: We need to be conservative: auto-rollback should be opt-in per template and per route. Also provide a dry-run and a safety lint that refuses dangerous param combinations (e.g., canary 100% without pin).

maria: Agreed. Proposed UX: three new subcommands on the deploy bot: `/deploy param save <name> --spec '<json|yaml>'`, `/deploy param list`, `/deploy --use-param=<name> [--overrides]`. And a lint command: `/deploy lint --use-param=<name>`.

aj: Example usage?

maria: Sure — here's a compact example you can paste.

```
# save a staging preset
/deploy param save staging-small --spec '{"env":"staging","pin":"svc@sha:abcdef","canary":0.1,"change_window":"08:00-10:00"}'

# run with preset and a one-off override
/deploy --use-param=staging-small --overrides '{"canary":0.25}' --dry-run

# lint before actually hitting prod
/deploy lint --use-param=staging-small
```

sam: That looks great. For rollbacks, can we put a small policy block in the param spec? e.g. `rollback: {enabled: true, error_pct_threshold: 3, lookback_mins: 5, min_traffic_pct: 5}`

maria: Yup. We can also allow a `manual_only: true` flag to prevent auto-unwind for sensitive flows.

ops_lead: How will telemetry feed into the bot? We need clear signals to avoid noisy false positives. Suggest we use the same datapipeline used by the console (per-route error rate + p50/p99 latency). The bot will compute delta vs baseline over a rolling window and only trigger if both absolute and relative thresholds are met.

maria: Good call. Implementation sketch: 1) param bank stored in a small service backed by k/v (encrypted) 2) deploy bot resolves the param into flags + policy 3) lint runs a static check + simulated rollout (checks pin presence, canary<=0.5 by default, change_window validity) 4) during rollout, poll metrics for lookback_mins and evaluate conditions.

aj: Can you show the lint output example?

maria: Sure. Example textual lint output the bot would post when you run `/deploy lint`:

```
Lint report for param "staging-small":
- pin: present ✅
- canary: 0.25 ✅
- change_window: 08:00-10:00 ✅ (matches allowed window)
- rollback policy: enabled (error_pct_threshold=3%, lookback=5m) ✅
- warnings: none

Suggested actions: run `/deploy --use-param=staging-small --dry-run` then schedule deploy in change window.
```

dev-bot: heads-up: i can implement `/deploy param` persistence and `/deploy lint` hooks in a PR. Need an RFC for the schema and a couple unit tests. :robot_face:

releasenotes-bot: FYI: we can auto-generate release notes from param descriptions if you add a `notes` field. small example: `notes: "adds canary 10% in staging; no schema changes"`. I can squash that into the release note draft.

sam: Action items: 1) maria to draft RFC for param schema + rollback fields 2) dev-bot to prototype persistence + lint hooks 3) ops to provide telemetry thresholds and the baseline query 4) AJ to write a small runner script that can test simulated rollouts locally.

aj: I'll take the runner script. Will post a WIP gist.

maria: I'll open the RFC today, link it here. If everyone is comfortable we'll land a small MVP that supports save/list/use, lint, and opt-in rollback detection.

ops_lead: Please include an escape hatch: `/deploy abort <thread_ts>` that cancels active auto-rollback and marks human-taken action. Also log audit trail to console and to customer-facing rollout notes.

maria: Will add. Thanks all — landing point: prototype then 2-week test on non-critical services. :+1:

aj: :thumbsup:

dev-bot: CI note: add unit tests for param serialization and a mock metrics endpoint for the rollback logic.

maria: Link to RFC: https://r.redwood/rfc/deploy-param-bank-2026 (WIP)

aj: Gist for runner WIP: https://gist.github.com/aj/deploy-runner-wip

ops_lead: Marking this as an RFC review thread, will comment on thresholds separately.
